activation: owner initialization and startup migration required; four UI display slots verified separately from designed task mapping
mapping_status: designed, not client_verified; preserve original field, amount and policy in receipts
initial_balances: explicit baseline only; no startup grant, no implicit reset of existing wallet
bound_silver_spending: npc_shop_bound only, under design/npc-shop-payments-v1.json; this additive purpose does not activate a shared NPC route or change existing balances/receipts
transfers: cash only, via cross-role transaction owner; this local module does not implement cross-role transfer
npc_depot_transfer: designed additive cash expense purpose: same-role cash wallet to explicit NPC depot cash, or reverse; no fee, no conversion, no cross-role operation; both balances and journal/common receipts must share one role lease transaction
npc_equipment_identify: designed additive cash-only purpose for design/npc-equipment-identification-v1.json fixed clean result; NPC exact original level quote, public Inventory CAS, fee/source/dedicated receipt and current reply encoding share one current-lease transaction. No other currency, legacy reset, default unidentified generation or shared route activation. Existing currency revision/fingerprints/receipts remain unchanged.
conversion: no automatic exchange or substitution between currencies
overflow_or_insufficient: reject whole caller transaction without partial spending
idempotency: role_id + settlement_id, fingerprint includes policy/purpose/source/deltas; conflicting reuse rejected
unknown_channels: PetExpReward and ShengWang remain separate; do not convert them into money
wire_bridge: currency_protocol: cash -> SRefreshMoney.kind1; bound_silver -> SRefSmoney; encode_yuanbao_balances requires both current yuanbao then bound_yuanbao in one response, each 0..2147483647; never zero-fill an unknown sibling; always current absolute balances
later_mapping_change: explicit ledger migration with original receipts preserved; never replay already settled rewards into a second currency
